posts.author: Apocalypticat
posts.body:
Hi all.
So, a pretty strange thing is happening. With an event, the player character should be able to climb (say, a wall). I am using regions for this. Although the wall tile from the tileset is marked as impassible, I am doing a region check to see if the player is standing on a specific region, and if so, it sets the movement route for the player as "Through On"...yet this isn't doing anything at all. The player is still blocked from traversing the wall. The region in question is painted at the foot of the climbable wall, and up the wall itself.
Any advice is appreciated.

posts.author: bgillisp
posts.body:
I see you use MZ so: If you use plugins some of them block regions from ALL event access. And I mean ALL. So check your plugins carefully.
A very common one that can do this is Event Move Core.
Odds are high you got region 8 set to all can't cross in a plugin somewhere, which means literally ALL. Including the player. Even with Through ON.

For anyone else facing this issue - if you use the Hendrix Action Engine plugin there is a setting that is enabled by default that blocks all tiles from the A3 and A4 tileset so that Though On doesn't work etc.
